spans.text: Even after the first-level appeal stage with an Administrative Judge, if the data bearing on the adjudicative outcome is still in dispute, the appellant has a right to file a second-level Director review. At this stage of the process, the case is examined by an appeals staff attorney to ensure the accuracy of the case file and determine the dispute.
